description: This file defines a class 'BorderRenderer' responsible for rendering a single border in RTF format within the MigraDoc document rendering system. It inherits from 'BorderRendererBase' and implements methods to render borders based on a document object model.

classes.name: BorderRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders a single border to RTF, inheriting from BorderRendererBase and associated with a specific Border object and RtfDocumentRenderer.

methods.name: BorderRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with a document object and an RTF document renderer.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Overrides the base method to render a border, setting the appropriate value and invoking the rendering process.

methods.name: BorderType (setter)
methods.description: Sets the type of border to render.
